connector.name: Xenarch MCP
connector.registryDescription: Xenarch - x402 MCP server for AI agent payments. Non-custodial, USDC on Base L2.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package agent-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xenarch-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: XENARCH_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Wallet private key (hex, 0x-prefixed). Auto-generates on first run if omitted.

env.name: XENARCH_MAX_PAYMENT_USD
env.description: Local per-call payment cap in USDC (default 1.00). The only spending ceiling in standalone mode; set 0 to disable. Connect XENARCH_API_TOKEN for managed per-tx/daily/monthly caps.
